cards.name: Traveler in the Dark Wood
cards.flavor: He woke up lost, and the straight path was gone.
cards.art: A bearded man in a torn cloak stands alone among dense trees at dusk.

cards.name: Trembling Pilgrim
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 1/1 Lost Shade.
cards.flavor: Every shadow looked like something to fear.
cards.art: A frightened man in a ragged robe cowers on a forest path with his hands raised.

cards.name: The Spotted Leopard
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: It blocked the sunlit hill, quick and bright-spotted.
cards.art: A spotted leopard with a sleek coat stands on a sunlit hillside.

cards.name: The Raging Lion
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: Hungry and proud, it charged up the hill toward him.
cards.art: A fierce lion with an open roaring mouth stands on rocky ground.

cards.name: The Hungry Wolf
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: Her hunger grows with every meal.
cards.art: A gaunt grey she-wolf with bared teeth stands on a barren plain.

cards.name: Horace, the Satirist
cards.text: Ward.
cards.flavor: A sharp wit, even in a place with no way out.
cards.art: A bearded Roman poet with a scroll sits in a quiet meadow beside a stone wall.

cards.name: Ovid, the Transformer
cards.text: Rebirth. On Play: Silence an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He wrote of bodies changed into new shapes.
cards.art: A poet holds an open book while a figure beside him slowly turns into a tree.

cards.name: Lucan, the Civil Poet
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: He sang of a war that tore Rome apart.
cards.art: A poet with a laurel crown stands before a field of broken shields and fallen soldiers.

cards.name: Homer, the Sovereign Poet
cards.text: Rebirth. On Play: Silence all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: The first and greatest of the poets, he leads the company.
cards.art: An old blind bard holds a lyre at the head of a group of robed poets on a grassy hill.

cards.name: Statius, the Faithful Poet
cards.text: Rebirth.
cards.flavor: He admired Virgil so deeply that he chose to follow him.
cards.art: Two robed poets walk together along a stone ridge above a dark ravine.

cards.name: The Heavenly Messenger
cards.text: Swift. On Play: Freeze an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He crossed the sky without a sound and opened the gate.
cards.art: A winged messenger in white robes stands before a tall iron gate in a city wall.

cards.name: Cato of Utica
cards.text: Guard. End of Turn: Gain 1 Armor.
cards.flavor: The guardian of the shore asks only that the way stay open.
cards.art: An old Roman man with a stern face stands on a rocky shore by the sea at dawn.

cards.name: Reed of Humility
cards.text: Ward. End of Turn: Restore 1 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: A humble reed can do what pride cannot.
cards.art: A tall green reed bends in a soft breeze beside a grey shoreline.

cards.name: Guiding Stars
cards.text: Start of Turn: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: The light that guided them out still burns the wicked.
cards.art: A cluster of bright stars shines above a frozen lake in a clear night sky.

cards.name: Beatrice, Sent from Heaven
cards.text: Ward. On Play: Restore 4 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Love moved her to leave Heaven and help a lost man.
cards.art: A serene woman in a flowing white gown stands among clouds with a gentle expression.

cards.name: Dante's Courage
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: He stood firm, though every step felt like falling.
cards.art: A determined man in a red cloak plants his feet on a steep rocky path.

cards.name: Swoon of Pity
cards.text: Last Breath: Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Hearing their story, he fell as if dead from pity.
cards.art: A pale man collapses to the ground, one hand pressed to his chest, in a stormy field.

cards.name: Harpy of the Wood
cards.text: Venom.
cards.flavor: She nests in a tree that cries out when it is broken.
cards.art: A winged harpy with a woman's face perches on a split, bleeding tree trunk.

cards.name: Brunetto Latini
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: My old teacher still walks the burning sand, still giving advice.
cards.art: An elderly man in a scholar's cap walks across burning sand under falling flames.

cards.name: Centaur Escort
cards.text: Swift. Start of Turn: Give a random friendly minion +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: He shoots at anyone who rises above the blood.
cards.art: A centaur with a drawn bow stands on a grassy riverbank beside a boiling red river.

cards.name: Serpent of the Pit
cards.text: Venom.
cards.flavor: Its bite poisons the sinner again and again.
cards.art: A coiled green serpent with an open jaw rests on a ledge of dark rock above a pit.

cards.name: Ciacco the Glutton
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He gorged himself, and he still wants more.
cards.art: A bloated man lies face down in thick mud under a grey sky with falling rain.

cards.name: Pier della Vigna
cards.text: Venom. Last Breath: Give a random friendly minion +1/+1.
cards.flavor: A loyal servant, now a tree that cries when it is broken.
cards.art: A gnarled dark tree with split bark, and a human face pressed into its trunk.

cards.name: Cleopatra, Queen of Lust
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: She ruled through desire, and now the wind carries her forever.
cards.art: A queen with a golden crown is blown by a stormy wind across a dark sky.

cards.name: Saint Lucy's Light
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: A heavenly light sent to guide a lost pilgrim.
cards.art: A radiant woman with a golden halo holds a lamp in a quiet room.

cards.name: Beatrice's Grace
cards.text: Restore 3 Health to your hero. Add a copy of Saint Lucy's Light to your hand.
cards.flavor: Her grace came down from Heaven and opened the path.
cards.art: A woman in a blue robe gazes down from a golden cloud over a green meadow.

cards.name: The Virgin's Mercy
cards.text: Freeze all enemy minions. Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Mercy from Heaven stops every enemy in its tracks.
cards.art: A veiled woman with open arms hovers above a ring of frozen stone figures.

cards.name: Virgil's Wisdom
cards.text: Gain an empty Mana Crystal. Add 2 copies of Rope Belt to your hand.
cards.flavor: Follow a wise guide, and the hard road becomes clear.
cards.art: An older poet with a laurel wreath points at a glowing scroll in a lamp-lit room.

cards.name: Rope Belt
cards.text: Freeze an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He dropped his cord into the abyss, and the beast came up to meet it.
cards.art: A coil of rope falls down a dark cliff into a deep chasm.

cards.name: Three Beasts Overcome
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: The leopard, the lion and the wolf all turned away at last.
cards.art: A leopard, a lion and a wolf stand in a row on a forest path.

cards.name: Ascent of the Mountain
cards.text: Gain an empty Mana Crystal. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Each step up the slope makes the next one easier.
cards.art: A narrow stone path climbs a sunlit mountain slope toward a bright sky.

cards.name: Veil of Stillness
cards.text: Silence a minion.
cards.flavor: One quiet word strips away its tricks.
cards.art: An open stone tomb with a grey cloth draped over its edge.

cards.name: Stars Again
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Gain an empty Mana Crystal.
cards.flavor: We climbed out of the dark to see the stars again.
cards.art: A dense field of bright stars spreads over a dark horizon.

cards.name: Dante's Resolve
cards.text: Destroy an enemy minion. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: He chose to face the danger and did not look back.
cards.art: A hooded pilgrim raises a dagger in front of a broken iron gate.

cards.name: Led Back to the Dark Wood
cards.text: Return an enemy minion to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: Sometimes the path forces you to go back the way you came.
cards.art: A grey wolf stumbles backward along a forest path, with a bright light behind it.
